verdict.rationale: Check is an API-first payroll platform, so a versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version headers, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The available items cover sandbox use, webhooks, the MCP server and the CLI, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
